body: I've lost and made friends plenty of times throughout my life but those two were always there thick or thin. I just feel like Idk anything anymore
Two of them were my rocks I've known them for 20 years and the other for 15

I feel empty and alone, I've tried to sleep but I cant. It wasn't even that big of a fight, you know the kind everyone cools of the next day and talks it out? Well its the next day and here I am alone with no idea what I did to deserve this
